notes.title: Heavy Fix Update!
notes.notes:
http://oi63.tinypic.com/2v823ci.jpg

I have compiled a pretty comprehensive list of fixes that the community have been asking for over the last month-ish and rolled them into tonight's build, major changes are:

-Joypad support for Zeke, Dutch, The 13th.
-Story mode rejigging to allow players to start with the full roster, removal of character collection.
-Overhauling the in-game lighting
-Overhauled music looping between stages, blended it a bit nicer.
-9 client cap on Perdition server added.
-Optimizations to the netcode so it should allow more people per server.
-Balance adjustments to story and arcade mode, mostly bullet speeds, it should be easier with some of the slower characters now.
-Zeke shooting buffs
-Abel reload buff now either flick or button press
-Streamlined story npc interactions.
-Lowered the visibility of Halloween update enemies to mostly VERY rare chance or Act 2 in story mode.
-And a bunch of smaller bug fixes...

Now there is a pretty good chance that there may be some introduced bugs since I have left it awhile since introducing new features, so if you find anything game breaking or just downright nasty, please post them here and I will quickly patch them out ASAP:    http://steamcommunity.com/app/229810/discussions/0/361787186440675617/

Cheers!

notes.title: Undeadorado Halloween Update coming shortly!
notes.notes:
Undeadorado Update will be dropping over the next week as it all gets cleared, changes and additions are as follows:

Spirit Totems- Will protect nearby enemies from damage.

Possessed Indians- As a result of a spirit totem, these enemies are invulnerable to your shots until your destroy the totem.

Bear Riders- First two stage enemy, you shoot the rider off and a bear will charge you afterward, will require some management so you don't agro all the bears at once.

Possessed Chickens- Fast moving creatures that leap toward you when they get close.  They will occasionally spawn in packs.

Cultist Hog Riders- Similar to the bear riders, the hogs move around quite unpredictably and have a two stage approach also.  Hogs also spawn separately in packs.

Spirits - Will appear to shoot and then fade out afterwards, you will have to do a lot of guess work to nail them down.  They appear and reappear at random when they don't have you targeted.

Super Bears- Giant bears, will act as a tank for the bear horde, they will charge you within a set range, aside from that they are slow and lumbering, keep your distance and shoot.  Standard bears will also have the charge mechanic added via the patch.

A pile of balance fixes are also going up over the Halloween period to address a few minor problems that have been on the fix list, mostly due to difficulty curve.  If you notice any bugs with the new enemies or features shoot me a message or post on the forums, thanks!

notes.title: StoryMode Fixes and Changes!
notes.notes:
http://oi62.tinypic.com/2873y9s.jpg

A few days out from release, I have uploaded a build with considerable Storymode changes and fixes through the game, changes are as follows:

-Ace card gain in storymode is now much more predictable, I have removed a lot of the random elements and increased the starting card limit, in addition, 60% of the levels will now have safes with cards in them.  I have also increased the card game price to play.

-Sheriff is now much less frequent as when you kill him it will remove your wanted level, there are only a few cases where he persists after you now, this should make him a little more forgiving over several levels.

-Skills are now purchased arcade style from a vendor rather than random drops, it has more calculation to it and overall it feels less random in building a character.

-Locations have been better signposted, neutral area signs and merchant areas are marked with midscreen events.

-Bear mode now has a better difficulty curve, arcade has changed slightly also.  Act 1 and 2 of storymode have been made slightly easier.

-Character gain % has been increased as lots of people have reported the gain rate is painfully slow.

-Notable bugs include the two player storymode exit north bug that bricks the game and a host of smaller less obnoxious bugs, including fixing the doubling up of sound in certain areas.

If you notice any bugs please post here or in the forums!  Thanks!
